play as ganondorf, with customizable options.

put ganondorf.dusk in dusklight's mods folder. the options are in the mods window, under ganondorf.
needs dusklight 2.0.2.

only windows has been played. mac, linux, android and ios are built here but untested.

- ganondorf over link, in every outfit or just the ones you pick
- his sword over any of link's swords
- silent option
